name: Lockfile origin guard
summary: Inspect staged lockfile origins before commit and reject insecure or unverifiable package sources.
description: A deterministic Claude Code PreToolUse gate for git commit that reads bounded staged lockfiles and blocks insecure transport, credential-bearing origins, missing integrity metadata, or local and Git package resolutions.
refuses: It does not regenerate, normalize, sign, install, or verify the full dependency graph.
It does not send package origins, credentials, integrity values, or repository content anywhere.
It does not claim that an accepted lockfile is reproducible, authentic, or vulnerability-free.
It does not allow command flags or repository files to disable a detected origin violation.

entrypoints.purpose: Inspect bounded staged lockfile metadata before commit and reject high-confidence unsafe dependency origins.
